scope: Presentation descriptions only: types, declarations, URLs, source statements, mathematical comparisons and review counts unchanged. Removed first-use context from shared library descriptions.

changes.name: Matrix.mulVec
changes.previous: Finite matrix-vector multiplication for each affine layer; biases and coordinatewise max can be added using the ambient operations.
changes.replacement: Finite matrix-vector multiplication, with each output coordinate equal to the dot product of a matrix row and the input vector.

changes.name: Set.image
changes.previous: Image of a family of laws under its subsystem-restriction map.
changes.replacement: The image of a set under a supplied map, with membership witnessed by a preimage in that set.

changes.name: Set.diff
changes.previous: Exclusion of the global-null family before imposing the unit-specific nonsignal condition.
changes.replacement: Set difference: elements in the first set that are not in the second.

changes.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous
changes.previous: Absolute continuity as preservation of null sets; apply in both directions to finite-time trimmed measures.
changes.replacement: Absolute continuity of one measure with respect to another, expressed by preservation of the latter measure’s null sets.

changes.name: Finset.filter
changes.previous: Selects exactly those units whose statistic satisfies the supplied strict threshold predicate.
changes.replacement: Filters a finite set by a supplied predicate, preserving the specified strict or non-strict boundary.

changes.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.map
changes.previous: Pushforward for an almost-everywhere measurable map, used to embed component priors in the common parameter space; nonmeasurable maps use an unrelated fallback law.
changes.replacement: Pushforward of a measure under an almost-everywhere measurable map; the nonmeasurable fallback does not have the intended pushforward interpretation.

changes.name: Int.floor
changes.previous: Integer floor, preserving possibly negative centered time offsets rather than truncating them to natural numbers.
changes.replacement: The greatest integer less than or equal to the supplied value, including negative values without natural-number truncation.

changes.name: Finset.powersetCard
changes.previous: All subsets of a given finite population with a specified cardinality, for fixed-size sampling without replacement.
changes.replacement: The finite family of all subsets of a supplied finite set having the specified cardinality.

changes.name: Set.Ioc
changes.previous: An interval open at the left endpoint and closed at the right, matching the bandwidth range (0,A].
changes.replacement: An interval open at its left endpoint and closed at its right endpoint.

changes.name: Set.Icc
changes.previous: An interval closed at both endpoints, matching the allowed location range [-A+h,A-h].
changes.replacement: An interval closed at both endpoints.

changes.name: IsLeast
changes.previous: Membership in a set together with being a lower bound of that set; expresses an attained smallest admissible distortion constant.
changes.replacement: Membership in a set together with being a lower bound of that set; expresses an attained least element.

changes.name: Finset.min'
changes.previous: Minimum of a nonempty finite set in its original ordered type; cluster counts may include zero even when the index set of clusters is nonempty.
changes.replacement: Minimum of a nonempty finite set in its original ordered type; a proof of nonemptiness is required.

changes.name: PMF.uniformOfFintype
changes.previous: Uniform law on a nonempty finite type, usable on fixed-cardinality subsets for sampling without replacement.
changes.replacement: Uniform probability mass function on a nonempty finite type.
